pages.text: Swaps two values.$(br2)Both values must have the same type, otherwise TYPE_MISMATCH is raised. To swap two variables, use them as parameters and as result targets.
$(li)$(1)a$() any type: the first value$(li)$(1)b$() the type of $(1)a$(): the second value$(li)result $(1)a$(): the value of $(1)b$()$(li)result $(1)b$(): the value of $(1)a$()
$(1)CALL SWAP$(br)  PARAMETER a left ;$(br)  PARAMETER b right ;$(br)  RESULT a left$(br)  RESULT b right$()
